$comment: ★★★ THE THREE REMAINING GNU `aligned` FORMS, EACH CONFERRED AND EACH OBSERVED THROUGH A REAL OBJECT (cycle P66, lane `ag`, closing [[D-C-THREE-GNU-ALIGNED-ATTRIBUTE-FORMS-REMAIN-AND-THE-WEAKENING-ONE-IS-SILENT]]). exit = 42; the three forms own DISJOINT exit codes — 10..13, 20..23, 30..33, plus 40 for the value check — so a partial fix names WHICH form it left broken instead of reading as a complete one. ★★ IT ASSERTS CONFERRAL, NEVER MERELY ACCEPTANCE: every arm reads `_Alignof` AND places a real object and observes it (`(char*)&g.v - (char*)&g`), because the whole lesson of this row's parent is that accepting-and-dropping trades a loud refusal for a silently mis-aligned object — a genuine fault on arm64, which is why the arm64 leg here is proven by EXECUTION and not by inspection. ── (1) A REQUEST WEAKER THAN NATURAL LOWERS. ✔MEASURED 2026-09-09, each reference probed SEPARATELY on its own translation unit, rc read DIRECTLY and never through a pipeline, at `-Wall -Wextra`: gcc 13.3.0 (`-std=c2x`), clang 18.1.3 (`-std=c23`), mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0 and aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc 13.3.0 ALL give `typedef int A2 __attribute__((aligned(2)));` an `_Alignof` of **2** (the `== 4` twin FAILS on all four), in BOTH orders, with `sizeof(A2)` still 4, and `struct T { char c; A2 v; }` sizeof **6** / align 2 / offsetof(v) **2** (the sizeof-8 twin FAILS on all four). DSS kept 4 and laid the struct out at 8/4, SILENTLY — ✔EXECUTED at the pre-change base, a DSS-built binary of that shape returned 10 where gcc, clang and aarch64-gcc under qemu all returned 42, so the divergence reached the OBJECT and was ABI-visible, not cosmetic. ⓘ MSVC 19.51.36257 abstains on the SURFACE (`__attribute__` is error C2061) and, through the spelling it implements, does NOT lower (`typedef __declspec(align(2)) int A2;` compiles rc 0 keeping `__alignof` 4, the `==2` twin failing C2118). Recorded AS a measurement and NOT read as a fork: MSVC has no `__attribute__((aligned))`, and increase-only is a documented property of a DIFFERENT attribute; gcc documents the asymmetry itself — on a TYPEDEF `aligned` may both increase and decrease, on a variable or a composite only increase. Three implementers, unanimous ⇒ required. ⛔ AND THE BOUND, WHICH IS WHY THIS FILE DOES NOT ASK A COMPOSITE TO LOWER: `struct __attribute__((aligned(1))) S { int a; };` keeps `_Alignof` 4 on gcc, clang, mingw AND aarch64-gcc (the `== 1` twin FAILS on all four), and a per-MEMBER `aligned(2)` does not lower either. Only the TYPE-LEVEL channel lowers; the other two keep their MAX folds and are pinned as controls in `tests/analysis/semantic/test_gnu_aligned_three_forms.cpp`. ── (2) A MID-LIST TYPEDEF DECLARATOR IS ACCEPTED AND CONFERS ON ITSELF ALONE. ✔MEASURED on the same four: `typedef int A __attribute__((aligned(8))), B;` compiles on all four with `_Alignof(A)==8` AND `_Alignof(B)==4` both PASSING and the `_Alignof(B)==8` twin FAILING on all four; three declarators with the middle one decorated gives 4/16/4. DSS drew `error[P_UnexpectedToken]` — below the union, loudly. ⚠⚠ THE `W4` ARM (exit 21) IS THE LOAD-BEARING HALF OF THIS FORM: a fix that conferred on BOTH declarators would be a NEW above-the-union defect that no acceptance test could see, because the program would still compile and still exit 42 on every arm that only checks A. ⚠ The binding is the OPPOSITE of the `[[deprecated]]` sibling lane `td` measured in the same slot the same day (which confers on **B**); neither generalises to the other and both were verified here rather than reasoned from one another. The decl-specifier PREFIX spelling has DECLARATION grain and confers on every declarator — also measured, also pinned, in the unit file. ── (3) THE ZERO-ARGUMENT FORM IS THE TARGET'S DECLARED MAXIMUM. ✔MEASURED: `typedef int AM __attribute__((aligned));` gives `_Alignof(AM)` **16** on all four references (the 8 and 32 twins FAIL on all four), independent of the decorated type, on a composite and on a member alike; ✔EXECUTED on x86_64 (gcc, clang) AND on aarch64 under qemu-aarch64, so 16 is measured on BOTH shipped targets rather than assumed from one. DSS drew `error[S_UnknownTypeAttribute]`. ★ 16 is what `x86_64.target.json` and `arm64.target.json` each declare as `aggregateLayout.maxAlignment`, and the engine READS it — never a constant in `src/`, never `if (arch == …)`. The old refusal's stated reason (this engine has no business INVENTING a target-dependent number) survives intact and is exactly what decided the fix: reading a DECLARED value is the opposite of guessing one. ⚠ It is NOT `maxRequestedAlignment` (2^28) — confusing the two would give every bare `aligned` a 256 MiB alignment. ⓘ This file asserts 16 rather than a symbol because both shipped targets declare 16 and all four references measure 16 on both; the CONFIG-DRIVEN half is pinned where it can be discriminated — `GnuAlignedThreeForms.TheZeroArgumentFormIsReadFromTheTargetNotCompiledIn` runs the SAME source under a params block whose only difference is `maxAlignment = 32` and requires the answer to move to 32, which a compiled-in constant cannot do. ── ORACLE, RUN AND NOT ASSUMED: `gcc -std=c17 -Wall -Wextra`, `clang -std=c17 -Wall -Wextra`, mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0 and `aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc` (under qemu-aarch64) all BUILD this exact file with stderr EMPTY and EXIT 42, at -O0 AND -O2. An example only DSS accepts is not a witness, it is a second copy of the bug. ── RED-ON-DISABLE, REMOVE DIRECTION, THREE MUTANTS ACTUALLY BUILT AND RUN THROUGH `ctest` (never a bare `.exe`), each reverted with its artefact md5 moved AND RETURNED. What they show is that the three forms fail INDEPENDENTLY and in DIFFERENT DIRECTIONS: ✔M1 (ENGINE — restore `layoutOne`'s `maxAlign` fold; src 317630b0 -> 4f8449e3 -> 317630b0, obj c75bd82e -> 71928ec2 -> c75bd82e, build rc 0 at both ends) ⇒ this file still COMPILES rc 0, the release image still differs from the baseline, and BOTH arms EXIT **10** — the silent-wrong-answer direction, and the whole reason this is a RUNNABLE witness rather than a parse pin. ✔M2 (CONFIG — take the `{repeat attrSpec}` off `typedefDeclaratorSlot`; c.lang.json md5 37c26bf3 -> f10f8122 -> 37c26bf3, no rebuild: the runners read `src/dss-config` at test time) ⇒ this file does NOT COMPILE AT ALL (`compile rc == 0` FAILS, rc=1), so the loud direction. ✔M3 (ENGINE — make `targetMaxUsefulAlignment` stop reading the declared target value; src f47bd4a2 -> a093671e -> f47bd4a2, obj 364f35f6 -> 8522d7bb -> 364f35f6, build rc 0 at both ends) ⇒ this file COMPILES rc 0 and EXITS **30** — accept-and-drop, the second silent direction, and the arm that proves the bare form is CONFERRED rather than merely tolerated. Three mutants, three different observable failures (10 / no-artifact / 30). Data-model-independent; one exit code across all four targets including the shipped release pipeline.
